EN: The Spreading Blight
ZH: 枯萎蔓延

EN: Get more information on the Tato blight.
ZH: 了解更多关于红果枯萎的信息。

EN: Meet up with another group of farmers that have been hit by the Tato blight.
ZH: 和另一群受到红果枯萎灾害影响的农民见面。

EN: They're a couple of tough cookies. I'm betting Sally would've taken cover in Vault 314. It's abandoned, so be careful!
ZH: 我打赌莎莉很可能会躲进314号避难所。那地方已废弃，千万小心！

EN: Thanks for the rescue! I thought we'd be feral chew toys by now.
ZH: 谢谢你们救了我们！还以为会像玩具一样被他们嚼烂了。

EN: And bite marks are so unbecoming!
ZH: 这咬痕也太难看了吧！

EN: By the way, did you see a girl and a dog?
ZH: 对了，你们有看到一个女孩和一只狗吗？

EN: We got split up during the ambush.
ZH: 我们在遭到伏击时走散了。

EN: No, do you know where they went?
ZH: 不是吧，你知道他们去哪里了吗？

EN: Overseer Emma said Bigsby stopped by their Vault. Since then, a salvage team took him on a run with them to the Atomatoys warehouse, but hasn't returned.
ZH: 监督者艾玛说比格斯比曾在他们的避难所停留，后来一个回收队带着它去了原子玩具仓库，就再没有回来。

EN: The Tail Continues
ZH: 继续追踪

EN: Find the salvage team.
ZH: 寻找救援队。

EN: Find the salvage team from Vault 899 in the old Atomatoys Warehouse.
ZH: 前往原子玩具仓库寻找来自899号避难所的回收队。

EN: After he visits the settlers at the RobCo Plant, he comes here to get updates on supplies and treasure to bring back to the Editor.
ZH: 他拜访完罗伯科工厂的定居者之后，来到了这里搜刮物资和宝物并带回给编辑。

EN: I'd talk to the settlers at the RobCo Plant. They were the first to get hit. They'd know the more about the Bugle Boy and his Editor.
ZH: 我会和罗伯科工厂的定居者谈谈。他们是最先被袭击的。他们应该了解更多关于“号角男孩”和编辑的信息。

EN: It was just before dawn... They came out of nowhere.
ZH: 就在破晓之前……他们不知道从哪里冒出来的。

EN: Everyone's dead. Everyone. It should have been impossible. We had unbeatable security!
ZH: 每个人都死了。每个人。这不应该啊，我们的安保系统固若金汤！

EN: This is the fault of that cursed Bugle! Your name gets mentioned, you get attacked.
ZH: 这是那个该死的号角报的错！它提到了谁的名字，谁就遭受袭击。

EN: The Bugle Boy told us that it would never fall into Raider hands.
ZH: “号角男孩”告诉我们它绝不会落入掠夺者的手中。

EN: Bugle Boy?
ZH: “号角男孩”？

EN: Any idea where the Bugle's offices are located?
ZH: 你知道号角报的办公室在哪里吗？

EN: Vault 404 was destroyed in a Raider attack... but Vault 120 might have more information.
ZH: 404号避难所在一次掠夺者袭击中被摧毁了……120号避难所可能会有更多的信息。

EN: The (Thinly Veiled) Plot Thickens
ZH: 迷雾重重

EN: Talk to the Overseer of Vault 120.
ZH: 同120号避难所监督者交谈。

EN: Talk to the Overseer at Vault 120 about the New Bugle.
ZH: 同120号避难所监督者谈论新号角报。

EN: The Thrill of the Hunt
ZH: 狩猎的战栗

EN: Here, let me show you.
ZH: 来，让我告诉你。

EN: You're risking life and limb for a recipe? That's kind of sad.
ZH: 你冒着生命危险去找配方？真可怜。

EN: Seems like he's got a bone to pick with you...
ZH: 好像他要找你麻烦……

EN: You guys looking for something?
ZH: 你们在找什么？

EN: Outfits? Certain death? Priceless junk?
ZH: 衣服？确定的死亡？无价的杂物？

EN: What was the second one again?
ZH: 第二个又是什么？

EN: We're here to retrieve a top secret culinary document.
ZH: 我们在这里取回绝密的烹饪文件。

EN: We've been sent on another suicide mission by our chef.
ZH: 我们被派去执行另一个自杀任务。

EN: Recipe? All I have is this blueprint for weaponized marinara.
ZH: 配方吗？我只有这张“武器化番茄酱”的蓝图。

EN: Well, we wouldn't want to disappoint him now, would we?
ZH: 我们不想让他失望，对吗？

EN: Convenient.
ZH: 真巧。

EN: End of the line, Dwellers. This is your final stop.
ZH: 终点线，居民们。这是你最后一站。

EN: Whatever possessed you to come to this place?
ZH: 什么使你来到这个地方？

EN: Surely you knew you were coming to your doom?
ZH: 你肯定知道自己要走向灭亡？

EN: We came for the recipe. Hand it over.
ZH: 我们来找配方。把它给我。

EN: I'm pretty sure our chef sent us here to get us killed.
ZH: 我很确定我们的厨师把我们送到这里来是为了杀了我们。

EN: We'd die for a good meal.
ZH: 我们愿为美餐而死。

EN: That Deathclaw steak was a bit... stringy, to say the least. The chef feels bad about this, and wants to make his favorite comfort food, lasagna. Unfortunately, Raiders have stolen his secret sauce recipe, and we need to get it back from their towering lair first.
ZH: 至少可以这么说，这死爪牛排有点老。厨师有点失落，想做他最爱的慰藉美食——千层面。不幸的是，掠夺者偷了他的秘密酱汁的配方，我们需从他们的高耸的巢穴里找回它。

EN: The Towering Il Forno
ZH: 高楼大厦

EN: Find the secret recipe.
ZH: 找到秘方。

EN: Retrieve the chef's secret recipe.
ZH: 找回厨师的秘方。

EN: Fifth floor:  housewares, ladies' lingerie, Radscorpions...
ZH: 第五楼：家居用品，女士内衣，辐射蝎……

EN: Just how tall *is* this building?
ZH: 这幢大楼有多高？

EN: That lasagna better be freakin' awesome!
ZH: 那份千层面最好超级好吃！

EN: We found the Vault-Tec notes on Vaultopolis! They say...
ZH: 我们找到了避难所科技留下来的关于避难所大都市的信息！他们说……

EN: There's something called a G.E.C.K. - a device that can create life!
ZH: 有一个叫做“伊甸园制造器”的东西 - 一个能够创造生命的装置！

EN: It could create a utopia Vault. A Vaultopolis! And Vault 525 had one!
ZH: 它能创造一个乌托邦式的避难所。一个避难所大都会！525号避难所有一个！

EN: But where IS Vault 525?! Is Paula there? We have to keep looking!
ZH: 但525号避难所究竟在哪儿？！宝拉在那里吗？我们必须得继续找！

EN: Vault 813's Overseer Alvarez told us the same thing he told Paula Plumbkin - to search the Vault-Tec offices for info on Vaultopolis!
ZH: 813号避难所监督者阿尔瓦雷茨告诉我们和告诉宝拉同样的事 - 去避难所科技的办公室找到关于大都会的信息！

EN: The Vault-Tec Vantage
ZH: 避难所科技优势

EN: Search the Vault-Tec offices for info on Vaultopolis.
ZH: 前往避难所科技办公室搜寻关于避难所大都会的信息。

EN: The Vault-Tec offices may hold info on Vaultopolis...
ZH: 避难所科技的办公室可能会有关于大都会的信息……

EN: You people, coming here, searching around! Stay off our turf!
ZH: 你们这些人来这里，想翻个底朝天？没门儿！赶紧滚远点！

EN: The Wizard of Water
ZH: 水之术士

EN: Good, 'cause there ain't much else here.
ZH: 很好，正好没什么其他人了。

EN: Yeah, that's probably a good idea. You should leave too.
ZH: 是啊，你说的对，你也应该离开。

EN: What are you guys doing here?
ZH: 你能在这里做什么啊？

EN: Don't you know this place is overrun by Radscorpions?
ZH: 你们不知道这个地方被辐射蝎占领了吗？

EN: I think I'm the only one left alive.
ZH: 我想我应该是留下的人里唯一活着的。

EN: Well, I think.
ZH: 嗯……我觉得是。

EN: We're here to harvest Radscorpion eggs, and nothing else.
ZH: 我们来这里不是为了别的，而是为了辐射蝎蛋。

EN: Our Vault isn't too far away. You should go there.
ZH: 我们的避难所不是很远，你应该去那儿。

EN: He probably thought you weren't up to the challenge. He was right!
ZH: 他可能觉得你不是能挑战自己的人。他说得对！

EN: Tell you what: you kill the critters, cut them up, and we'll take it from there.
ZH: 这样吧，你杀死那些生物，把他们劈开，然后剩下的交给我们吧。

EN: And split our share of the eggs with you? No way, José!
ZH: 然后和我们去分享这些蛋？做梦吧，约瑟！

EN: Whew! We thought you were Radscorpions for a moment.
ZH: 吁！瞬间还以为你是只辐射蝎呢。

EN: Must have been the smell...
ZH: 一定是因为味道……

EN: Those things are aggressive *and* radioactive. Just... nasty.
ZH: 这些东西非常具有攻击性而且带着辐射。就……很糟糕。

EN: Good thing that Vault chef is paying us extra for those eggs.
ZH: 好在避难所大厨会多付我们钱来作为这些蛋的报酬。

EN: Wait a minute, did our chef hire you guys as well?
ZH: 等等，大厨也雇佣了你们吗？

EN: Sorry, but we're getting those eggs.
ZH: 不好意思，恐怕这些蛋是我们的。

EN: Hey, what if we joined forces?
ZH: 嘿，要不然我们联手？

EN: The chef never ceases to be amazed by your uncanny ability to escape death, and he wants to celebrate it with a Radscorpion egg omelet. Vault 923 was recently overrun by these critters, so that'd be a good place to start.
ZH: 大厨对你死里逃生的能力表示惊讶。他想用辐射蝎蛋卷来庆祝。923号避难所最近被这些生物侵占了，不妨就从那里开始吧。

EN: The Yolk's on You
ZH: 蛋黄之争

EN: Kill the Glowing Radscorpion and harvest its eggs.
ZH: 消灭发光辐射蝎，拿走蝎子蛋。

EN: Rescue any surviving Dwellers.
ZH: 拯救幸存的居民。

EN: Bring Radscorpion eggs back to the chef.
ZH: 将辐射蝎蛋带回给大厨。

EN: You know what? I don't like Radscorpions much...
ZH: 你知道吗？我不太喜欢辐射蝎……

EN: I'm starting to think our chef wants to kill us...
ZH: 我在想也许大厨想杀了我们……

EN: We'll be done here in a pinch!
ZH: 我们瞬间就能搞定这里！

EN: Darn it! The Jersey's not here. The search continues!
ZH: 该死的！棒球衫不在这里。继续搜索！

EN: There's an old Hardware Town store we haven't checked out. Maybe Coach went there to resupply. Off we go.
ZH: 有一家旧的“五金小镇”商店我们还没去看过。也许教练去那里补给物资了。我们出发吧。

EN: There's no Crying in Baseball!
ZH: 棒球场上没有眼泪！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Hah! You know who gives us the best chance to win? Me!
ZH: 哈！你知道谁最大程度上保证了咱们能赢吗？我！

EN: My playoff run is only getting started, and I will go all the way!
ZH: 我的季后赛征程才刚开始，我会一路杀到底的！

EN: What?! You found me? I can't believe it!
ZH: 什么？！你找到我了？真不敢相信！

EN: What's wrong, Commish? Feeling a little... deflated?
ZH: 怎么了，“总裁”？觉得有点……泄气？

EN: Your little Super Cup contest is over, Commish.
ZH: 你的那个愚蠢的“超级杯”要结束了，“总裁”。

EN: Thanks!
ZH: 谢谢！

EN: Help! These Raiders have lost their minds!
ZH: 救命！这些掠夺者疯了！

EN: They're obsessed with a pre-war sport called foosball!
ZH: 他们很痴迷于战前的一种游戏，叫桌上足球！

EN: At least, that's what I think they called it...
ZH: 至少我听见他们好像是这么叫的……

EN: There's a Vault nearby. You'll be safe there.
ZH: 这附近有一个避难所。你去那里比较安全。

EN: You've tracked the kidnapped settler to the lair of the Commish. Time to put an end to this football flunky's Super Cup contest!
ZH: 你已经知道被绑架的定居者在“总裁”那里。是时候终结这个足球怪人的“超级杯”比赛了！

EN: Third and Goal
ZH: 第三和目标

EN: Rescue the hostage.
ZH: 拯救人质。

EN: Confront the Commish.
ZH: 和“总裁”对峙。

EN: Rescue the hostage and confront the Commish.
ZH: 拯救人质并与“总裁”对峙。

EN: Time for some big play offense!
ZH: 是时候来个大进攻了！

EN: You're goin' back to the practice squad!
ZH: 准备好被打回预备队吧！

EN: What? No, it's a sixpack of Nuka-Cola Quantum!
ZH: 什么？不，这只是一箱六瓶装的量子核子可乐！

EN: Oh, we don't care then. Here, for your troubles.
ZH: 哦，我们不在乎。来，这是给你们的辛苦费。

EN: We hate when Dwellers makes fun of our grammar! Die!
ZH: 我们讨厌居民取笑我们的语法！去死吧！

EN: *Hiss* Filthy Dwellers, coming to steal from us.
ZH: 嘶——肮脏的居民，想来偷我们的东西。

EN: They want our prize!
ZH: 他们想要我们的奖品！

EN: We hate them! We kill them!
ZH: 我们讨厌他们！我们要杀了他们！

EN: Is your “prize” some sort of gold jewelry, by chance?
ZH: “奖品”不会是某种黄金首饰吗？

EN: I don't want your “prize,” whatever it is. I'm looking for gold.
ZH: 我不想要你的“奖品”，不管它是什么。我在找金子。

EN: You don't kill us, we kill you!
ZH: 你不杀我们，我们就杀了你！

EN: Love is in the air, and just like radioactive fallout  - once it gets inside you it doesn't get out! All we need now is a ring to pop the big question. We might have some luck finding Pre-War jewelry in a nearby abandoned building.
ZH: 空气中弥漫着爱意，就像放射性尘埃——一旦进入体内就再也出不来！我们现在需要的是一枚戒指来求婚。在附近的废弃建筑里说不定能找到一些战前珠宝。

EN: This Golden Ring
ZH: 这枚金戒指

EN: Find any item made of gold.
ZH: 找到任何黄金做的物品。

EN: Retrieve Pre-war Jewelry to make a ring.
ZH: 取回战前珠宝来制作戒指。

EN: The things we do for love...
ZH: 我们为爱做的事……

EN: Baby, I love you like fluorine loves hydrogen.
ZH: 宝贝，我爱你就像氟爱氢气。

EN: Wuv conquers all!
ZH: 爱能征服一切！

EN: Then eat this!
ZH: 那么尝尝这个！

EN: That nut wearing the Baseball Jersey? Aint seen him! Now beat it.
ZH: 那个白痴穿着棒球衫？没见过他！现在滚吧。

EN: Oh. Okay then. Nice work.
ZH: 哦，好吧。干得不错。

EN: Yeeeaaahhhh!
ZH: 耶耶耶耶耶！

EN: What? Vault Dwellers? Ugh. I HATE Vault Dwellers!
ZH: 什么？避难所居民？呃。我讨厌避难所居民！

EN: You come here to die, is that it?!
ZH: 你来这里是为了去死的，对吧？！

EN: We came to kill Raiders and eat Cram. And we're all out of Cram!
ZH: 我们来是为了杀死掠夺者然后吃饱饱牌肉罐头的。我们的饱饱牌肉罐头都吃完了！

EN: We're looking for a guy named Coach. You seen him?
ZH: 我们在找一个叫教练的人。你们有见过他吗？

EN: We're not Vault Dwellers! We killed them, and stole their suits!
ZH: 我们不是避难所居民！我们杀了他们，然后拿了他们的衣服！

EN: That's it! We've had enough of you... you... Bad guys!!
ZH: 够了！我受够了你们这些……坏蛋！！

EN: Some Raiders have taken over an old apartment complex. Maybe these jerks know the big jerk, Coach. Can't hurt to ask!
ZH: 一些掠夺者占领了一幢旧的复式公寓。也许这些混蛋们知道教练这个混蛋在哪儿。问问也无妨。

EN: Throw Me Some Pepper!
ZH: 给我一些胡椒！

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Do the Raiders know where Coach is?
ZH: 掠夺者们知道教练在哪儿吗？

EN: Oregano, I'm not!
ZH: 牛至，我不是！

EN: You had it cumin.
ZH: 你得了，小茴香。

EN: Careful, I don't saffron fools gladly.
ZH: 小心点，我才不高兴惹傻瓜呢。

EN: Salt! I mean... halt!
ZH: 盐！我的意思是……停止！

EN: Basil, Rosemary, keep these guys at Bay (leaves).
ZH: 罗勒，迷迭香，把这些家伙挡在外面(离开)。

EN: If they move, Pepper them with bullets.
ZH: 如果他们动了，就用子弹向他们扫射。

EN: Are you done?
ZH: 你搞定了吗？

EN: So many puns, so little thyme.
ZH: 双关语太多，百里香太少。

EN: What's anise girl like you doing in a place like this?
ZH: 像你这样的大茴香姑娘在这样的地方干什么？

EN: Bring it on!
ZH: 放马过来！

EN: Whoa. Mind = Blown.
ZH: 哇。脑子=炸了。

EN: No cayenne do, daddy-o!
ZH: 不要吃辣椒，老爹！

EN: Holy moley, it's the fuzz!
ZH: 我的天，是条子！

EN: Have you come for our stash, narc?
ZH: 你来盘点过我们了吗，缉毒员？

EN: We won't give it up without a fight!
ZH: 我们不会不战而退的！

EN: I have no idea what you're saying.
ZH: 我不知道你在说什么。

EN: You know these are just seasonings, right? Like, to add flavor?
ZH: 你知道这些只是调味料，对吧？我是说，增加风味？

EN: You're busted, buster! Hand over the mustard!
ZH: 你被逮着了，伙计！把芥末交出来！

EN: All right, the Super-Duper Mart was a bust as far as ingredients go. This time, though, we have a sure lead to a cache of spice in a nearby building! And the chef is convinced the Raiders will just hand it over...
ZH: 好吧，你要找原料的话，大无敌超市不是个啥好去处。但是这回，我们肯定能在附近的一座建筑里找到一些香料！ 厨师相信那些掠夺者会把它们交出来……

EN: Thyme is Money
ZH: 珍贵的百里香

EN: Retrieve the spice.
ZH: 找到香料。

EN: Eliminate the Raider Boss.
ZH: 除掉掠夺者首领。

EN: Steal some spices from a band of Raiders.
ZH: 从一伙掠夺者那里偷点香料。

EN: Keep calm and curry on.
ZH: 保持冷静，继续咖喱下去。

EN: I mint to do that.
ZH: 我很勒意那样做。

EN: What a load of horseradish!
ZH: 真是一派胡言！

EN: Still no Jersey! The Wasteland sure is a cruel mistress!
ZH: 还是没有棒球衫！废土真是个残酷的地方！

EN: Our next stop is an old Chryslus Rocket '69 plant. It's as good a place to look as any.
ZH: 我们的下一站是克莱斯勒69号火箭工厂。最好还是和其他地方一样去看看吧。

EN: Time for a Grand Slam?
ZH: 大满贯时间？

EN: Search for Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Find Rackie Jobinson's Baseball Jersey.
ZH: 寻找罗基·杰宾森的棒球衫。

EN: Yay! Teamwork! Here, I'll even split some of Caps I found in this place.
ZH: 耶！团队作战！来，我会把我在这里找的一些瓶盖分给你们。

EN: Oh, there it is. Tricky! Thanks!
ZH: 哦，在这里。不容易啊，谢谢啦！

EN: Hey! Wait, are you here because of this stupid alarm clock, too?
ZH: 嘿！等等，你来这里也是为了那个愚蠢的闹钟吗？

EN: I was camped nearby, and the sound was driving me nuts!
ZH: 我在附近露营，那些声音要把我逼疯了！

EN: Raiders need a solid eight hours!
ZH: 掠夺者必须保证八小时的充足睡眠！

EN: We'll help you break it! Then we'll go our separate ways!
ZH: 我们会帮你打碎它的！然后我们再分道扬镳！

EN: There's got to be an off switch. Have you looked on the back?
ZH: 一定有个开关能把它关上。你们有检查过它的后面吗？

EN: Someone made the mistake of activating a Wakemaster prototype alarm clock in a building not far from the Vault. Now the alarm is blaring non-stop and it's keeping everyone up!
ZH: 有人犯了个错误，激活了距离避难所不远的一幢建筑里的“叫早大师”原型闹钟。现在这个闹钟叫个不停，吵得每个人都睡不着。

EN: Time to Wake Up!
ZH: 起床时间到！

EN: Turn off the alarm clock.
ZH: 关掉闹钟。

EN: Stop the incessant beeping of the world's loudest alarm clock.
